none: PAS NLM-C29A48: Roman Coin: Radiate of Tetricus I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate of Tetricus I (271-274), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust bearded and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]C TET[---]. Reverse description: Female figure standing left holding ?wreath and anchor, possibly Laetitia. Reverse inscription: [---]AVGG. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 15.6mm, Weight: 1.10gms, die axis: 12
